arayes.title: Arayes
ingredients: 4 each small pitas, cut in half
1 each yellow onion, grated & squeezed dry
0.5 cup greek yogurt  [For the Garlic Tahini Sauce]
3 tbsp tahini  [For the Garlic Tahini Sauce]
0.5 each lemon, juiced  [For the Garlic Tahini Sauce]
2 each garlic cloves, minced  [For the Garlic Tahini Sauce]
2 tbsp olive oil  [For the Garlic Tahini Sauce]
0.25 cup fresh parsley, chopped  [For the Garlic Tahini Sauce]
0.25 cup fresh cilantro, chopped  [For the Garlic Tahini Sauce]
1 tsp each: cumin, salt, pepper, paprika  [For the Garlic Tahini Sauce]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Grate your onion and squeeze every last drop of liquid out using paper towel or cheesecloth.
In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, tomato paste, minced garlic, all the spices, parsley, cilantro (if using), and that very dry grated onion. Mix with your hands for about 2 minutes.

Cut each pita in half. If they don’t already have a pocket, carefully use a knife to make one. Now, pack them with your beef mixture — and I mean stuff them. You want them full but not bursting (ripped pita = heartbreak).

Crisp ’Em Up: Brush the outsides of the stuffed pitas lightly with olive oil. Heat a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat. Place each arayes meat-side down and sear for 1–2 minutes until you get that gorgeous crust. Then sear the pita sides until golden and crisp.
Transfer the seared arayes to a baking sheet and finish them in the oven for 10–15 minutes, until fully cooked through.
While they bake, whisk together all the garlic tahini sauce ingredients in a bowl. Taste and adjust lemon, salt, or garlic levels to your liking.
When the arayes are hot out of the oven, optionally brush them with melted garlic herb butter. Totally optional… but trust me, it hits. Enjoy!
Spices: 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp cinnamon, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp allspice

Olive oil

You will need also

Add the chicken cooked pieces to a bowl,add the buffalo sauce, garlic powder and black pepper and mix well. Slice the rolls in half lengthwise or use pre sliced rolls.

In a baking dish arrange the bottom half of the dinner rolls, arrange the cheese slices , add all the chicken, range sauce and grated cheese, place the other half of the white rolls on top , in a small bowl add the melted butter, chopped garlic, chopped parsley, pinch of sweet paprika and black pepper and mix well, brush the tops of the rolls with the garlic butter.. Bake on 180C until cheese is melted and the bread is golden brown.

caramelized-onion-and-garlic-spaghetti.title: Caramelized Onion and Garlic Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 cup cream or coconut milk, room temperature
instructions: Seasonings (1 tsp each): paprika, garlic powder, salt, pepper, italian seasoning
Slice your onion like it owes you money, mince that garlic (use fresh please), and measure out all your seasoning. Bring a cup of cream or coconut milk to room temperature.

Heat 2 tbsp butter + 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium. Add in the onions and let them vibe for 15–20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden and jammy. If they start sticking, hit ‘em with a splash of water.
While your onions are caramelizing like sweet little angels, boil a pot of salted water and cook the pasta until al dente. Drain, but don’t forget to save some of that pasta water — it’s liquid gold.

When the onions are deeply golden, stir in your minced garlic and all the seasonings. Let it all bloom for a minute, then add the chili crisp and saute for a minute. Pour in your cream (or coconut milk). Let it simmer and get cozy for a few minutes then add the grated Parmesan cheese.
Add your pasta to the sauce and toss to coat. Use that reserved pasta water to loosen things up if it’s too thick — you’re going for silky, not sticky.
Serve hot with an extra spoon of chili crisp on top for a spicy kick and maybe a sprinkle of fresh parsley if you’re feelin’ fancy.

chicken-alfredo-wrap.title: Chicken Alfredo wrap
ingredients: 2 lb boneless chicken breast  [For the chicken]
1 tbsp smoked paprika powder  [For the chicken]
1 tbsp chosenfoods avocado oil  [For the chicken]
1 tbsp chosenfoods avocado oil  [For the chicken]
2 tbsp butter  [For the creamy Alfredo sauce]
1 tbsp garlic, minced  [For the creamy Alfredo sauce]
1 cup whole milk  [For the creamy Alfredo sauce]
0.33 cup chosen foods mayonnaise  [For the creamy Alfredo sauce]
0.75 cup parmesan cheese, freshly grated  [For the creamy Alfredo sauce]
1 each salt  [For the creamy Alfredo sauce]
0.5 tsp black pepper  [For the creamy Alfredo sauce]
1 tsp garlic powder  [For the creamy Alfredo sauce]
0.5 tsp italian seasoning  [For the creamy Alfredo sauce]
1 tsp dried parsley  [For the creamy Alfredo sauce]
6 each large flour tortillas wraps  [To assemble]
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the chicken, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and 1 tablespoon avocado oil. Mix until the chicken is evenly coated and let marinate for at least 15 minutes.

Heat the remaining tablespoon of avocado oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and fully cooked through. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant.

Pour in the milk and whisk until smooth. Add the mayonnaise and continue whisking until fully combined. Stir in the Parmesan cheese, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, and parsley. Cook for 2–3 minutes, stirring frequently, until the sauce becomes thick and creamy.
Lay the tortillas on a flat surface. Divide the chicken Alfredo mixture sauce among the tortillas and top each with shredded mozzarella cheese. Add the Alfredo sauce on tip
Fold in the sides of each tortilla and roll tightly into wraps.
Place the wraps seam-side down in a clean skillet over medium heat. Toast for 2–3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and crispy, and the cheese has melted.
Slice in half and serve immediately.

chipotle-steak-bowl.title: Chipotle Steak Bowl
ingredients: 1 each chipotle peppers in adobo sauce
instructions: Marinate 1 ribeye steak with chipotle peppers in adobo sauce. Cover and refrigerate overnight, or 1–2 hours before cooking.
Sear the steak: Heat 1 tablespoons oil in a cast iron or pan over high heat. Sear steak for 2 minutes per side. Season with salt and cumin while cooking.
1 cup washed jasmine rice on the stovetop. Add 2 cups of water and drizzle of oil. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook until water is fully absorbed and rice is tender.
Finish the rice with a drizzle of oil then mix in 0.3 cups fresh cilantro, chopped, 0.5 teaspoons salt, and 1 lime, juiced.
Plate & serve: Slice the ribeye against the grain and serve over the cilantro lime rice.

cinnamon-rolls-made-in-20-minutes-and-ev.title: Cinnamon rolls
ingredients: 1 each vanilla bean or vanilla bean paste  [Vanilla Bean Glaze]
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F and grease or line your pan
In a bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon
Warm milk slightly, then mix in vanilla and melted butter
Pour wet into dry and mix until a soft dough forms, stop as soon as it comes together, don’t overmix
Lightly flour your surface, roll dough into a log, flatten slightly, and cut into 20 even bites
Toss each piece in melted butter, then coat fully in cinnamon sugar
Place in pan in a single layer with a little space between each, no stacking
Bake 9 to 10 minutes, until lightly golden, don’t overbake
While baking, mix glaze until smooth, adjust thickness if needed
Let bites cool 1 to 2 minutes, drizzle glaze over the top while warm, and enjoy
⏱ Time & Servings
Prep 10 min
Cook 10 min
Serves 2 to 3
Pro Tip
Mix just until the dough comes together, overmixing is what makes these dense instead of soft and pillowy.

instructions: In a large bowl coat chicken breast with about 2 tsp of olive oil, seasonings, salt and mix until evenly coated. Cover and set aside for 30 minutes to marinate.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado oil and 1 tbsp of butter.
Sear chicken for 5 minutes per side until a golden crust forms. Deglaze pan with a little chicken broth, lower the heat, cover, and simmer until internal temperature reaches 155F.
Remove chicken from pan, cover in foil, and place into oven set warm.
Pasta
Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Salt it heavily.
Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
Reserve at least 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain.
Sauce
To the same pan (medium heat) add butter.
Sauté shallot for 1–2 minutes until soft.
Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant (about 30 seconds).
Season with oregano, garlic powder, chili flakes, salt, and black pepper. Mix until well combined and fragrant
Pour in heavy cream and mix
Simmer gently for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened.
Lower heat and stir in Parmesan cheese and pasta water. Mix until well combined. Taste and adjust for seasonings.
Add cooked fettuccine and parsley, mixing until well coated.
Stir in an additional ¼ cup Parmesan until fully combined.
Finish with chopped parsley.
Add sliced chicken on top of pasta
Finish with extra Parmesan, cracked pepper, or chili flakes if desired.

Remove the chicken and in the same pan add olive oil and butter to saute onions and garlic for a few minutes until translucent.

instructions: Trim excess fat from boneless chicken thighs. Add to bowl with Mexican seasoning, lime juice and olive oil. Mix well to marinate.

Add washed uncooked rice to a pot of water, bring to a boil then simmer on low heat until fully cooked. Once cooked, let it cool, add chopped corianderwith lime juice and pinch of salt. Mix well then set aside.
Get a large lined sheet pan, spread marinated chicken evenly then oven bake for 23 mins at 200C/390F and broil for 5-6 mins until golden brown, charred and juicy.
Remove chicken from pan, add sweetcorn, red onion, garlic powder and paprika. Mix in all the chicken juices then flatten evenly. Oven roast for just 15 mins until crispy.
Add roasted corn to a large mixing bowl, with all listed ingredients then mix well until creamy and delicious.
Chop the chicken into cubes, serve with cilantro lime rice and street corn salad and ENJOY!

this-is-seriously-one-of-the-best-appeti.title: Roasted Tomato Burrata Dip with Garlic Bread Crostinis
ingredients: 1 each salt, pepper, red pepper flakes
1 each butter, garlic, salt, parm, parsley
instructions: Add cherry tomatoes to a baking dish and drizzle generously with olive oil (enough to coat the bottom of your dish).
Season with salt, pepper, red pepper flakes, garlic, parsley, and oregano.
Bake at 425°F for 20-30 mins until tomatoes burst (you can gently smash them halfway if they need some assistance in the ‘bursting’ process).
While that bakes, slice a French bread baguette, spread with garlic butter (butter, garlic, salt, parsley, parm), and toast 5–7 mins until golden.
Once you’re ready to serve, top with parm, fresh basil, and burrata. Stir it all together and serve HOT.
Dip. Scoop. Repeat. This one is next level tasty definitely a heavy appetizer, perfect to bring to a party or to serve at your next gathering.
